rationale: The measured workload is dominated by large cases 09-11 where each thread performs one scalar load and one scalar store with a division/modulo for row/col. Switching to an xy layout with grid=[cols,rows] removes the integer division and modulo entirely, and using a 16x16 threadgroup keeps the same 256-thread product while improving locality of the output writes along the contiguous output row dimension. The copy remains a single 32-bit load and store, preserving every bit pattern and leaving all output padding untouched.
